name: Hello Mod
description: The example mod: a page, a home card, one tool, a notification and an event.
author: Jaron Wilson

steps.title: Wave
steps.body: Press **Wave** on the Hello page. Hello Mod sends you a notification and publishes a `hello.waved` event that other mods can react to.

steps.title: Pick a greeting
steps.body: Choose the word Hello Mod greets people with. Odysseus keeps it as this mod's settings.

steps.title: Ask the agent
steps.body:
In a chat, say *greet Ada with the hello mod*: the agent calls the `hello_greet` tool.

The **Hello Mod** card on Home counts the waves and greetings.
